turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Who decided on Owen's zero, and when?
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.
Report cards wait for nobody. Neither does Owen's zero. Who decided?
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
I haven't heard anything yet. What do you have besides the checker?
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
Kind to each other. Owen found out from his phone, in class. Show me your evidence.
